title: Users
subtitle: An account is created on first Discord sign-in. Its role decides what it may do.
emptyDescription: Accounts show up on their first Discord sign-in.

dialog.title: Change {{user}}'s role
dialog.description: A role decides what this account may do everywhere. Being a server admin is separate: it only grants starting and stopping that one server.
dialog.helper: Only roles whose permissions are a subset of yours are offered.

guards.self: You cannot change your own role: demoting yourself is the easiest mistake to make and the most painful to undo.
guards.lastOwner: The last {{role}} cannot be demoted: nobody would be left to manage roles.
guards.noAssignableRole: No role is assignable by you: you may only assign a role whose permissions are a subset of your own.
